utterances.speaker: ARSENIJE KRNOJELAC
utterances.text: We would also unload the feed that we brought back, et cetera.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Do you own a house in Zavajt?

utterances.speaker: ARSENIJE KRNOJELAC
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Does your brother Milorad own a house in Zavajt?

utterances.speaker: ARSENIJE KRNOJELAC
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You must be aware that your brother Milorad was a teacher in Zavajt for a while?

utterances.speaker: ARSENIJE KRNOJELAC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Do you know where he lived while he was a teacher in Zavajt?

utterances.speaker: ARSENIJE KRNOJELAC
utterances.text: In the school. There were two schools there, an old one and a new one. The old house was refurbished and turned into a building used for accommodation, and it contained four separate flats. And the other school was used for teaching.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: When Milorad finished with this job, did he return that apartment to the school?

utterances.speaker: ARSENIJE KRNOJELAC
utterances.text: That apartment remained the property of the school, and another teacher moved in. I don't suppose that Milorad could have taken it with him, the apartment, I mean.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: While you were working at the KP Dom, did you ever drive to Zavajt 2 to a barrel maker, and do you know if there is a barrel maker in Zavajt?

utterances.speaker: ARSENIJE KRNOJELAC
utterances.text: There is no barrel maker in Zavajt. If you ask me --

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Interpreter's note, the interpreter does not really understand the word used by the witness.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HUNT
utterances.text: Mr. Bakrac, the interpreters are having trouble with one of the words the witness is using.

utterances.speaker: MR. BAKRAC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You said that there was no barrel maker, and you said, "If you ask me whether there is" -- and then you used a word. Could you tell us what that word was and what it means? I think you said "jelika." Can you tell us what that means?

utterances.speaker: ARSENIJE KRNOJELAC
utterances.text: It's a coniferous tree. It's actually a fir tree used for manufacturing, roofing and furniture and other things. That's what they have in Zavajt, fir trees.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I didn't quite understand you. Does -- is it the case that there is -- that they have this type of tree in Zavajt or is there a workshop processing that kind of timber?

utterances.speaker: ARSENIJE KRNOJELAC
utterances.text: No. I didn't mean a workshop. There is no workshop. They have that kind of tree there.

utterances.speaker: MR. BAKRAC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] May I ask the usher -- I don't believe that the witness has this Exhibit D154 in front of him.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HUNT
utterances.text: Are we going to be left up in the air about the conifer trees? What on earth has this got to do with this case? 25 MR. BAKRAC: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I really don't know. That's what the witness said. I have never heard about any of this before, and I cannot possibly know what was in his mind. I've tried to clarify, but I just think that the witness said there was no barrel maker, and using some kind of jargon, he said they had some particular type of tree. But if you want me, I'll try again.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HUNT
utterances.text: No, no, please. No, no. But just see if you can exert a little bit of influence by leading him to where it is you want to take him, so that you take him to the subject you want him to discuss and just not leave it to him to work out what he wants to say. I can understand he wants to tell us the whole story. We really do not need to know all this detail.

utterances.speaker: MR. BAKRAC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I agree, Your Honour, believe me. I'm doing my utmost to keep this short. And on the other hand, I don't want to restrain this witness completely because we will not be able to get on the transcript what he is saying, and some of it is important to the Defence.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Sir, I will ask you just to tell me briefly, can you see in front of you the piece of paper with a name on it. The usher will now show it to you. Will you please read this name, to yourself, though. Don't say it aloud because it is a protected name, and next to that name there is a number, number 73. Have you read the name? Please don't say it aloud, just read the name and tell us -- have you done that?

utterances.speaker: ARSENIJE KRNOJELAC
utterances.text: Yes, I have read it.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Tell me, have you ever driven that person, the person bearing that name number 73, to Zavajt or anywhere else?

utterances.speaker: ARSENIJE KRNOJELAC
utterances.text: No. I never travelled to Zavajt.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Have you ever made any comments in front of that person, the position of your brother in the KP Dom?

utterances.speaker: ARSENIJE KRNOJELAC
utterances.text: No. There was never any need for me to do that. There was never any need for me to make any comments about him.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Do you remember driving that person anywhere at all, or can you remember any situation when that person was present?

utterances.speaker: ARSENIJE KRNOJELAC
utterances.text: No, I don't. I don't remember any such thing.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: For the record, can we clarify this? Is it the case that you don't remember, or rather that you remember never having been with him or driving him?

utterances.speaker: ARSENIJE KRNOJELAC
utterances.text: I didn't drive him.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Do you remember, have you ever told anyone that you advised your brother Milorad to refrain from taking that position at the KP Dom?

utterances.speaker: ARSENIJE KRNOJELAC
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. BAKRAC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours, my colleague is warning me about the time. Looking from my angle, it seems to be 4.00.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HUNT
utterances.text: Not quite, but we've got something to say before we go. We've got the videolink tomorrow, so we'll start off with the two witnesses, the taking of their evidence, and Mr. Krnojelac will have to wait until their evidence is taken before he resumes. Right. We'll adjourn now until 9.30 in the morning.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HUNT
utterances.text: be reconvened on Wednesday, the 6th day of June, 2001, at 9.30 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 4.00 p.m., to
